cohort: A single patient with hereditary angioedema who used icatibant during three pregnancies, supplemented by other cases identified through a literature review.
finding: Icatibant use during pregnancy was associated with healthy infant outcomes in the reported case series and literature review, although one infant was born preterm, with all children meeting developmental milestones and no reported birth defects.
gest_age: For the reported cases, infants were born at term or 1-month preterm.
